rules.startFrom: LiveScore daily fixture board for each historical date
rules.lookaheadLeakage: Use only information that existed before each fixture kickoff.
rules.marketOdds: Historical pre-match odds only; unavailable stays unavailable.

researchSnapshot.rule: Use only information verifiably available by 06:00 SAST on each historical target date; exclude all later information from the frozen FIH assessment.

fixtureEligibility.countingRule: Only eligible fixtures are counted in the backtest denominator and proceed to research/model/evaluation.

metrics.reason: Hard stop: full seven-day V1/V2 evaluation would be invalid until structured pre-06:00 evidence is reconstructed and persisted for every eligible fixture.

previousBaseline.reason: Fixture-specific external web research required by FIH_BUILD_STEPS.md was skipped.

researchProgress.notes: Research resumed in fixture order on 2026-09-29. Pre-06:00 SAST dated sources are accepted; sources first published after cutoff and post-match information are rejected. Evidence fields unavailable from verified pre-cutoff sources remain UNAVAILABLE. No model stage is allowed until fixture research records are persisted and verified.
researchProgress.verifiedFinding: Current historical artifacts do not contain the structured pre-06:00 last-five/venue/PPG/xG/opponent-strength evidence required to run FIH V2 leak-free across 1,583 fixtures.
researchProgress.currentTurnResearch: Additional fixture-specific searches confirmed that valid pre-cutoff sources exist for a subset, while same-day/post-cutoff/current result pages must be rejected.

hardStop.reason: Generating V2 inputs from current/post-result pages or treating preview-only searches as complete evidence would introduce look-ahead leakage or fabricated structure. The signed policy requires every eligible fixture to have persisted, verified fixture-specific evidence before modeling.
hardStop.requiredResolution: Create a scalable historical web-research reconstruction stage that records source publication time and structured evidence fields for every fixture before model execution. This is a material pipeline addition and cannot be silently substituted during a backtest.
